svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How existing ductwork decides whether central air or a mini split costs less
svg.desc: If the house already has good ductwork, replacing the central unit is typically cheaper than a multi-zone mini split, so central air often wins on upfront cost. Without ducts, central air means installing them, a major expense, so a mini split is often the cheaper path.
svg.text: The cost question: do you already have good ducts?
